create_Normal: create a Normal distribution with loc and scale parameters from PyTorch tensors
test_Normal_rsample: test the Normal distribution rsample method to generate reparameterized random samples
test_Normal_log_prob: test the Normal distribution log_prob method to compute log probability of values
test_Normal_cdf: test the Normal distribution cdf method to compute cumulative distribution function
test_Normal_entropy: test the Normal distribution entropy method to compute differential entropy
